about.title: About Us – North Adams Municipal Employees Federal Credit Union

data.contentHtml:
Who We Are

North Adams M.E. Federal Credit Union was chartered January 1, 1959, in North Adams, Massachusetts. For over 60 years, we've served municipal employees and their families.

We're member-owned, not-for-profit, and focused on helping you save, borrow, and plan for the future, without the fees and hassle of big banks.

media.alt: Bird's-eye View of North Adams, MA; from a 1905 postcard published by the Detroit Photographic Company.

data.innerHtml:

NAMEFED membership is open to employees and retirees of:

Board of Directors

We have a volunteer Board of Directors that sets loan and dividend rates, amends policies, and makes important decisions for the Credit Union. Meetings are held on the second Monday of every month at 4:30 PM at the Credit Union office.

Board positions are open. If you're interested in serving, please call us at (413) 662-2657.

Branch Hours

{{hoursTableHtml}}

We are closed on federal and Massachusetts bank holidays. NAMEFED follows the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston holiday schedule.

{{@holidays}}

Friendly Reminder: Due to our day closing procedures, all transactions must be in by 3:30 PM for same-day processing. Requests after 3:30 PM will be processed the next business day.

media.alt: Norad Mill, 60 Roberts Drive, North Adams

data.innerHtml:
Savings & Dividends

Share Savings and Christmas Clubs: .10% APY. Dividend rates are subject to change without prior notification. Minimum $5.00 to open and maintain your account with annual activity.

{{tableHtml}}

Loan Rates

Rates approved by Board of Directors December 15, 2025. All rates based on APR. Loan rates are on a Risk-Based Pricing scale determined by Debt Ratio & Credit Score. Rates subject to change without prior notification.

{{tableHtml}}

Contact us for full rate details. We will match any competitor's rate with Board approval. Just ask!

data.introHtml: Find answers to common questions about NAMEFED. Can't find what you need? Contact us. We're happy to help.

items.a: Our routing number is 211871234. Use it for direct deposit, wire transfers, and ACH setup. You'll also find it on your checks and in your account materials.

Membership is open to employees and retirees of the City of North Adams, North Adams Public Schools, North Adams Fire and Police Departments, Northern Berkshire EMS, North Adams Housing Authority, and North Adams City Yard. Immediate family members of current members may also join. See full eligibility details.

We're open Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–4:00 PM. Summer hours (typically June–August): Monday–Thursday 9am–4pm, Friday 9am–1pm. All transactions must be in by 3:30 PM for same-day processing. View full hours and holiday schedule.
We're at Norad Mill, 60 Roberts Drive, Suite 112, North Adams, MA 01247. Get directions and more details.

items.q: How much do I need to open an account?
items.a: Just $5.00 to open a Share Savings account. You'll need a valid government-issued ID, Social Security card, and cash or check made payable to NA ME Fed Credit Union. Apply for membership.
Not at this time. We're a small, branch-based credit union. You can visit us during business hours or call (413) 662-2657. We're exploring online banking for the future.

items.q: What if I leave my job or move away?
items.a: Once a member, always a member! We just require annual activity in your account to keep it open. You don't lose membership if you change jobs or relocate.

items.q: How do I set up direct deposit or payroll deduction?
items.a: Contact us for our routing number and your account number. We can provide a direct deposit form, or your employer may have their own. For payroll deduction on loans, we'll work with your employer once your loan is approved.
Yes. Your savings are federally insured to at least $250,000 by the NCUA (National Credit Union Administration), backed by the full faith and credit of the United States Government.

items.q: How do I apply for a loan?
items.a: Visit the branch or call (413) 662-2657 to speak with staff. We offer auto, personal, and seasonal loans. View current rates. We will match competitor rates with Board approval. Just ask!
